svg.title: The cloud counted into cells, at two resolutions
svg.desc: The same drone's cloud 30 s ahead. Each particle covers its own A5 cell and one ring round it (its protected zone), so a cell's probability is the share of particles whose zone covers it. At resolution 15 (cells about 180 m) the core cells are certain; at 17 (about 44 m) the probability spreads over more, smaller cells.
